why_this_paper_matters: This paper identifies AGK as a regulator of mitochondrial ROS and membrane potential in GBM cells, linking its upregulation to poor prognosis. The study demonstrates that AGK suppression induces cellular senescence via mitochondrial dysfunction, which paradoxically enhances TMZ resistance. Targeting AGK and senescence represents a promising strategy to improve TMZ therapy for GBM patients with poor prognosis.
